channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Inside the D.O.J.’s Investigation of Fauci and Other Virus Scientists
item.description: As Dr. Anthony Fauci has faced public scrutiny from congressional Republicans, the D.O.J. has pursued a quieter and more expansive effort against a wider circle of researchers.

item.title: NPR: Opinion: A sculpture in perpetual motion, removed
item.description: "Blue," a statue that's been on the grounds of the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. for 7 years has been dismantled and removed.

item.title: BBC News: Reform promises to increase tax-free personal allowance to £15,000
item.description: The party says the tax cut will be paid for by reducing public spending by £80bn.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘This is colonialism for clicks’: the influencers attempting to meet and film the world’s most isolated tribes
item.description: A new breed of adventurer is chasing internet fame by targeting uncontacted peoples. Critics say they are risking the wellbeing of these remote communities – and their own lives He set out from the beach around midnight,…

item.title: Al Jazeera: How big is Africa really? Why the UN voted to change the world map
item.description: The new map makes Africa, Latin America, South Asia and Oceania larger than the traditional Mercator projection.

item.title: Ars Technica: After 8 years, Europe's BepiColombo mission is on final approach to Mercury
item.description: "Fundamentally, we want to learn about the origins of this planet and how it came to be like it is."

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Pangram Has Emerged as the Gold Standard of AI Detection. Should You Trust It?
item.description: Meet the AI police who can make or break careers—in publishing and beyond.

item.title: WIRED Science: Scientists Put Caterpillars in an Ultraquiet Chamber to Learn How They Hear Without Ears
item.description: The research could do more than help unlock the mystery of caterpillar hearing. It could also help make microphones better.

item.title: WIRED Business: Who Cares if AI Is Conscious—It’s Basically Alive
item.description: While philosophers ponder AI consciousness, the models have ideas of their own.

item.title: The New Yorker: Why the Lindsay Clancy Trial Ended in a Deadlock
item.description: Both the prosecution and the defense tried to tell tidy stories. But, in the end, five weeks of testimony from more than eighty witnesses couldn’t resolve the central mystery of Clancy’s state of mind.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: The New Dad Getting Laid While the Baby Sleeps
item.description: In this week’s story, a 42-year-old married guy calls the sitter and wonders how other parents of newborns do it.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Triple-Threat Prewars and the Case for Kips Bay
item.description: This week’s worth-it New York City apartment listings.
